findings.reason: the plan states the base of both medians, and naming the reader (the stamp-derived figure from `read_records`) rather than the field is what keeps the measured shares the quantity the section claims to report.
findings.text: the changed bullet fixes the denominator of every share as "its ledger row's `wall_seconds`", but `reckon/ledger.py` documents two distinct quantities under that name: `read_records` returns a stamp-derived span (`read_records` docstring: "``wall_seconds``, the span between that row's own ``dispatched_at`` and ``completed_at`` stamps"), while the stored field `runs()` carries is not that span ("The stored field carrying the first name is never passed through — on nearly half the ledger it is a different quantity from the span"), and `runs()` warns "Use read_records for stamp-derived duration rather than the stored wall_seconds carried here"; the bullet names the field without naming the reader, so a node reading `ledger.runs(project)` gets the stored figure that disagrees on nearly half the ledger and the medians in the same section are computed against a wrong denominator
